title: One More Morning in the Dolomites
route: Selva di Val Gardena → Santa Maddalena → San Giovanni in Ranui → Lago di Tovel → Brescia
introTitle: One last morning in the mountains.
intro: Depart Selva di Val Gardena for two classic Val di Funes photo stops: the Santa Maddalena panorama and San Giovanni in Ranui church. Continue to Lago di Tovel for a weather-dependent 60–75-minute lakeside photography stop before returning to Brescia. Plan lunch in Cles or Tuenno en route or bring a picnic, as lakeside dining may be closed in late October. Check lake access road and weather conditions before departure.

stops.name: Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Begin the morning in the heart of Val Gardena before heading toward Val di Funes.

stops.name: Santa Maddalena — Val di Funes
stops.description: Spend part of the morning in Val di Funes, surrounded by the dramatic Odle peaks and classic Dolomite scenery.

stops.name: San Giovanni in Ranui — Val di Funes
stops.description: Photograph the isolated St. Johann church against the Odle peaks from the permitted viewpoint. Allow around 15–30 minutes, plus local travel and walking; respect access restrictions.

stops.name: Lago di Tovel
stops.description: Spend about 60–75 minutes photographing the lake, forest and Brenta Dolomites. Late-October access depends on road and weather conditions. Bring lunch or stop in Cles/Tuenno; do not assume seasonal lakeside restaurants are open.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave the Dolomites behind and return to Brescia for the next stretch of the adventure.
